verdict.rationale: Cross-content search is a fair question for a planning and tracking tool, but the evidence pack never documents search across tasks, docs, or comments, or any claim about result speed or accuracy. The nearest items are adjacent: chart filters (github-docs-10) are a different feature, and querying project items through the API (github-docs-15) is a developer building block, so neither earns credit.

support.subject: As an engineer, I can search across all tasks, docs, and comments and get fast, accurate results
